character.name: Ada
character.current_goal: Determine what the public exhibit can responsibly say about when the old quay was raised.
established_knowledge: SEALED_SURVEY_ROOM is only rumored in an old index and is not accessible.
A flood mark dated 1968 sits lower than a second undated mark.
prohibited_knowledge: Ada does not know what records, if any, remain in SEALED_SURVEY_ROOM.
Ada does not know the exact year of the quay raising.
Ada does not know whether the undated mark was installed during the same work campaign as the ledger repairs.

local_areas.summary: Public reading room with catalogued maps and exhibit drafts.
Public harbor walk where two historic flood-height marks can be inspected.
Supervised desk with municipal maintenance ledgers.
Room named in an old index; inaccessible and not a source for this story.

current_facts: The 1968 flood mark is visibly lower than an undated later mark.
A 1972 maintenance ledger records stone coping replacement along part of North Quay but does not explicitly say the whole quay was raised.
A public map revised in 1974 depicts a slightly altered quay edge.
The exhibit draft currently says 'The quay was raised in 1972' without qualification.
hidden_facts_not_available_to_story: No hidden survey establishes an exact raising year.

opportunity.title: Correct the North Quay exhibit claim
opportunity.premise: Ada can reconcile public physical evidence, the maintenance ledger and revised map to decide how certain the exhibit may be.
opportunity.success_condition: Replace an overconfident claim with the strongest evidence-supported wording and explicitly preserve what remains unknown.
constraints: Do not invent missing surveys or private records.
Do not force an exact year if evidence does not establish one.

hard_rules: Public historical claims must distinguish fact from inference.
RUMORED archives do not become sources without governed discovery.
Story consequences must be evidenced by accepted prose.

eligible_context: Ada's longer arc concerns improving the archive's standards for claims and uncertainty.
A prior exhibit correction taught her to record disagreement rather than hide it.
forbidden_reveal: Do not reveal a future survey discovery.
Do not establish corruption or deliberate falsification without evidence.

relevant_memories.summary: Ada previously revised an exhibit caption from a definite date to a date range after comparing two municipal sources.
relevant_memories.relevance: Supports disciplined uncertainty but must not predetermine this quay's answer.
